title: 第5章 拔剑术
content_zh:
云海宗距离扬州城万里之遥，即使千里雪能够日行千里，林枫依旧用了十天时间才到达。

不过这十天林枫也没有浪费，茫茫疆域踏马而行，上一世的林枫何曾有过这种热血感受，在不知不觉中他的心境得到突破，武道上也顺利踏入了气武境七重境界，水到渠成，另外武技九重浪也修炼到了最后一重，一浪九重！

如今的林枫，拥有近乎八千五百斤的强大力量，厉害无比。

云海宗位于云海山脉主峰云海峰上，云海峰并非是山脉最高的山峰，但地域辽阔，从天上往地上看，就可以看到云海峰仿佛一个山中之城，被八柱最高的通天山峰围绕在里面，风水极佳，在九霄大陆，风水，即是气运。

“站住，下马前行。”山脚，两名守山弟子将林枫阻拦住，冷喝说道。

林枫眉头一挑，指了指前方骑在马上进山的人影道：“我怎么不见你们拦他。”

“哼。”其中一人冷笑道：“你凭什么和别人内门子弟相比，差点被打死的废物。”

原来还是身份实力的缘故，林枫笑了笑，云海宗的守山弟子不过是一个摆设，和他一样都是外门弟子，若是有客人前来就前往通知宗门，哪里有什么权力阻拦人，不过是打杂的而已，更不用说拦下骑马的宗门子弟了。

“弱者就是要受人欺凌。”林枫冷笑一声，不但没有下马，反而一甩缰绳，千里雪呼啸向前。

“废物，你敢。”两人同时爆喝，想要阻止，却见林枫双拳齐出，顿时一股澎湃的力量凶猛传来，直接将他们震飞了出去。

“若有下次，废了你们修为。”林枫骑马呼啸而过，只有拿实力出来才有话语权，那两名守山弟子爬起来，骇然的看着林枫离去的身影，随即露出苦笑，连废物都比他们强了，难怪他们只是守山弟子。

在云海宗，十五六岁的年龄的少年大多是气武境六重或七重境界，这算资质普通，气武境八重则算优秀，至于气武境九重，则可以称作天才，被宗门重点关注，至于能以十五六岁踏足灵武境的武修，在整个雪月国都能算是顶尖的天才。

和那些天才相反，若十五岁还是停留在气武境五重，就只能说资质低下了，算是云海宗天赋最差的，因此林枫才得了一个废物之名，被人耻笑。

林枫回来的消息很快在云海宗外门子弟中传开，他这‘废材’在云海宗还算是小有名气的，走在云海宗内，林枫见到周围人群各种神情，充耳不闻，径直朝着云海宗星辰阁方向走去。

星辰阁是云海宗存放功法和武技的地方，每天都有不少宗门子弟前往星辰阁，今天自然也不例外。

“林枫。”一道声音传来，林枫停下脚步，目光转过，随即他便看到一面色阴冷的少年。

“你的命真大，这都没死。”少年正是上次要了林枫命的林恒，林浩然的大儿子。

林枫扫了林恒一眼，心中冷笑，气武境八重境界而已，如今的他凭借气武境七重修为加上九重浪，丝毫不逊色对方，只要再修炼一两套武技，他有把握战胜林恒。

因此林枫没有理会林恒，直接进入了星辰阁，先提升自己的实力再报仇。

“下一次，我一定会让你死的不能再死。”林恒见到林枫无视自己，眼中闪过一道森冷的杀机。

星辰阁殿门前有着一位老者，随意的坐在那，目光懒散。

“前辈。”林枫对着老人微微躬身，虽然对方仅仅是一个守阁老人，非常不起眼，但星辰阁何等重要的地方，只有他一人守护，可见对方绝非看起来的那般简单，就好比前世某电视剧中少林寺藏经阁的扫地僧，深不可测，两世为人的林枫如何会看不明白。

老人懒散的目光微微一凝，诧异的看了林枫一眼，随即对着林枫点了点头：“七重气武境，只能在星辰阁一楼挑选功法武技，最多两套。”

“明白。”林枫应了一声，星辰阁共分三层，气武境修为的弟子又没有内门令牌，便只能挑选一楼的功法和武技。

星辰阁一楼的功法和武技都是黄级，但数量极多，在这里可以找到最适合自己修炼的功法武技，这就是宗门的底蕴，不是他林家能比得了的。

功法林枫暂时不需要，因此他主要在放置武技的书架上寻找。

“七杀拳，一拳七杀，适合体系武魂拥有者修炼。”

“飓风斩，借助风的力量，化作风刃攻击，适合风武魂拥有者修炼。”

“蛮牛决，黄级上品功法，适合兽系武魂拥有者修炼。”

林枫翻看着手中的武技，然后又放下，他的武魂是黑暗武魂，能够增强武修的所有素质，包括领悟能力，因此对他而言不存在限制，任何武技他都可以修炼，这正是黑暗武魂的变态之处，所以他希望找威力强大的武技。

“清风剑决，剑如清风，轻灵飘逸，无孔不入，适合剑武魂拥有者修炼。”

林枫的目光微微停顿了下，他向往仗剑行江湖的快意恩仇，因此对剑有着说不出的情绪，不过这套清风剑术似乎并非他所想要的。

“拔剑术，拔剑若雷霆，一击必杀，适合剑系武魂拥有者修炼。”

“拔剑术。”林枫的脚步停下，这拔剑术似乎和其它的剑法不同，剑客最不想要的就是拔剑的那一刻，因为耽误时间，影响出剑，然而拔剑术却是讲究拔剑必杀，剑出必见血，在出剑的那一刹那威力最强，一击不中，就代表失败。

而且拔剑术没有和其它武技一样分为几重，只有一重，一个动作，拔剑、杀人，做到极致者，剑出、饮血。

“就它了。”林枫将拔剑术收好，然后准备挑选一部轻功身法，毕竟他可能保证每一次都能一击必杀，若是失败，拥有好的身法武技也能够瞬间逃离，赢得缓冲时间，而且，凌波微步、飞檐走壁，可是每一个地球人的梦想啊！

林枫接下来挑选了一套名为浮光掠影的身法武技，练到最强境界能做到身若浮光，只见影，不见人。

收获不错的林枫将两本武技拿到守阁老人处登记。

“拔剑术。”老人低呼一声，道：“小伙子，拔剑术这门武技可是第一次被人挑选，你要知道，别人剑已出，你却拔剑，你的速度很难快过对方，而如果你速度不够快的话，结局就已经注定，可以说这武技练到强是很强，但要求太高，你要做到极致的快，比任何对手都快，才能一击必杀。”

“我明白。”林枫知道对方是好意提醒自己，如果拔剑不够快，那拔剑术不但无法做到出剑饮血，反而起反作用，让自己陷入危局。

“你清楚就好，没有把握最好别乱用，这浮光掠影倒是不错的身法武技。”老人也不多言，帮林枫登记好，毕竟在星辰阁挑选的武技功法都必须要在一个月内归还，不能影响其他想修炼的宗门子弟。

“多谢前辈指点。”林枫接过武技，然后恭敬的对着老人道谢。

“嗯。”老人笑着点头：“这柄软剑平时可以当腰带用，放在我这也没什么用，你拿着去玩吧。”

“别谢了，老头子可受不了，滚去修炼吧。”老人见到林枫又要道谢，微笑着挥了挥手。

林枫摸了摸脑袋，将谢意放在心头，拔剑术，如果配上能挂在腰间的软剑，出其不意，一击必杀的把握绝对大增。

对着老人微笑着点头示意，随即林枫便离开了。

“很久没见到这么有趣的年轻人了。”老人低语了一声，随即又恢复了懒散的模样，如今的年轻人都只顾修炼提升实力，越来越浮躁，早已将基本的礼仪忘到一边。
content_en:
Yunhai Sect is thousands of miles away from Yangzhou City. Even though Qianli Xue can travel thousands of miles in a day, it still took Lin Feng ten days to arrive.

However, these ten days were not wasted by Lin Feng. He traveled across the vast territory. Lin Feng had never had such a passionate feeling in his previous life. Unknowingly, his state of mind was broken through. In terms of martial arts, he successfully entered the seventh level of the Qi Martial Realm. It was a matter of course. In addition, the ninth level of martial arts was also cultivated to the last level, the ninth level of One Wave!

Today, Lin Feng has a powerful strength of nearly 8,500 kilograms, which is extremely powerful.

Yunhai Sect is located on Yunhai Peak, the main peak of the Yunhai Mountains. Yunhai Peak is not the highest peak in the mountain range, but it covers a vast area. Looking from the sky to the ground, you can see that Yunhai Peak is like a city in the mountains, surrounded by the eight tallest peaks of Tongtian Peak. It has excellent Feng Shui. In Jiuxiao Continent, Feng Shui is luck.

"Stop, dismount and move forward." At the foot of the mountain, two disciples guarding the mountain stopped Lin Feng and shouted coldly.

Lin Feng raised his eyebrows, pointed to the figure riding a horse in front of him and said, "Why didn't I see you stop him?"

"Hmph." One of them sneered: "How come you are a loser who was almost beaten to death compared to other people's inner disciples?"

It turned out that it was because of his status and strength. Lin Feng smiled. The Yunhai Sect's mountain guarding disciples were just decorations. They were all outer disciples like him. If there were guests coming, they would go and notify the sect. There was no right to stop them. They were just handymen, let alone the sect disciples who were riding horses.

"Weak people will be bullied." Lin Feng sneered. Instead of dismounting, he flicked the reins and Qianli Xue roared forward.

"You trash, how dare you." The two of them yelled at the same time, trying to stop them, but they saw Lin Feng's fists coming out, and a surging force suddenly came, knocking them away.

"If there is a next time, I will destroy your cultivation." Lin Feng roared past on horseback. Only by showing his strength can he have the right to speak. The two mountain guarding disciples got up and looked at Lin Feng's leaving figure in shock. Then they smiled bitterly. Even the trash was stronger than them. No wonder they were just mountain guarding disciples.

In Yunhai Sect, most of the young people aged fifteen or sixteen are at the sixth or seventh level of the Qi Martial Realm, which is considered to have ordinary qualifications, while the eighth level of the Qi Martial Realm is considered excellent. As for the ninth level of the Qi Martial Realm, they can be called geniuses and are focused on by the sect. As for martial arts cultivators who can set foot in the Lingwu Realm at the age of fifteen or sixteen, they can be considered top geniuses in the entire Xueyue Kingdom.

Contrary to those geniuses, if he is still at the fifth level of the Qi Martial Realm at the age of fifteen, it can only be said that his qualifications are low, and he is the worst talented person in Yunhai Sect. Therefore, Lin Feng got the name of a waste and was ridiculed by others.

The news of Lin Feng's return quickly spread among the outer disciples of the Yunhai Sect. He, a 'waste', was quite famous in the Yunhai Sect. Walking in the Yunhai Sect, Lin Feng saw various expressions on the faces of the people around him. He turned a deaf ear and walked straight towards the Yunhai Sect's Xingchen Pavilion.

Xingchen Pavilion is the place where Yunhai Sect stores their martial arts and martial arts. Many disciples of the sect go to Xingchen Pavilion every day, and today is no exception.

"Lin Feng." A voice came. Lin Feng stopped and turned his eyes. Then he saw a young man with a cold expression.

"You are so lucky, you are not dead yet." The young man was Lin Heng, Lin Haoran's eldest son, who took Lin Feng's life last time.

Lin Feng glanced at Lin Heng and sneered in his heart. He was only at the eighth level of Qi Martial Realm. Now, with the seventh level of Qi Martial Realm and the ninth level of waves, he was not inferior to his opponent in the slightest. As long as he practiced one or two more sets of martial arts, he was sure to defeat Lin Heng.

Therefore, Lin Feng ignored Lin Heng and entered the Star Pavilion directly to improve his strength first and then take revenge.

"Next time, I will definitely make you die so hard." Lin Heng saw Lin Feng ignoring him, and a cold murderous intention flashed in his eyes.

There was an old man in front of the Xingchen Pavilion, sitting there casually with lazy eyes.

"Senior." Lin Feng bowed slightly to the old man. Although the man was just an old man guarding the pavilion and was very inconspicuous, he was the only one guarding such an important place as the Star Pavilion. It was obvious that the man was not as simple as he seemed. He was just like the sweeping monk of the Sutra Pavilion of the Shaolin Temple in a TV series in his previous life. He was unfathomable. How could Lin Feng, who had lived in two lifetimes, not understand it.

The old man's lazy eyes narrowed slightly, and he glanced at Lin Feng in surprise, then nodded to Lin Feng: "At the seventh level of Qi martial arts, you can only choose exercises and martial arts on the first floor of Xingchen Pavilion, with a maximum of two sets."

"Understood." Lin Feng responded. The Star Pavilion is divided into three floors. Qi Martial Realm disciples do not have inner gate tokens, so they can only choose the exercises and martial arts on the first floor.

The exercises and martial arts on the first floor of Xingchen Pavilion are all yellow-level, but there are a lot of them. Here you can find the exercises and martial arts that are most suitable for your practice. This is the foundation of the sect, and it is not something that the Lin family can match.

Lin Feng didn't need the martial arts at the moment, so he mainly looked for them on the bookshelf where martial arts were placed.

"Seven Killing Fist, seven kills with one punch, suitable for practicing by system martial spirit owners."

"Hurricane Slash uses the power of wind to turn into a wind blade attack. It is suitable for practice by wind martial spirit owners."

"Manniu Jue, a top-grade yellow-level technique, suitable for practice by owners of beast-type martial arts spirits."

Lin Feng looked at the martial arts in his hands, and then put them down. His martial soul was a dark martial soul, which could enhance all qualities of martial arts, including the ability to comprehend. Therefore, there were no restrictions for him. He could practice any martial arts. This was the abnormality of the dark martial soul, so he hoped to find powerful martial arts.

"The Qingfeng Sword Technique, the sword is like the breeze, light and elegant, pervasive, suitable for cultivation by sword martial spirit owners."

Lin Feng's eyes paused for a moment. He longed for the pleasure and revenge of traveling through the world with a sword, so he had indescribable emotions towards the sword. However, this set of Qingfeng swordsmanship did not seem to be what he wanted.

"The sword-drawing technique is like thunder. It kills with one strike. It is suitable for sword-type martial soul owners to practice."

"Sword drawing technique." Lin Feng stopped. This sword drawing technique seems to be different from other sword techniques. The last thing a swordsman wants is the moment of drawing the sword, because it delays the time and affects the sword draw. However, the sword drawing technique emphasizes that the sword must be drawn to kill, and the sword must be bloody. The sword is most powerful at the moment when the sword is drawn. Missing a hit means failure.

Moreover, the art of sword drawing is not divided into several levels like other martial arts. There is only one level, one action, drawing the sword and killing people. Those who achieve the ultimate level will draw the sword and drink blood.

"That's it." Lin Feng put away the sword-drawing technique, and then prepared to choose a Qinggong movement. After all, he could guarantee a one-hit kill every time. If he failed, with good movement and martial arts, he could escape instantly and gain buffer time. Moreover, walking on the waves and flying over the wall were the dreams of every person on earth!

Lin Feng then chose a set of martial arts skills called Floating Light. After practicing to the strongest level, he could make his body appear as if it were floating light, only seeing shadows but no one.

Lin Feng, who had made a good harvest, took the two martial arts books to the old man guarding the pavilion to register them.

"Sword Drawing Technique." The old man whispered and said: "Young man, this is the first time that the sword drawing technique has been selected by others. You have to know that if someone else has already drawn their sword, but you draw it, it is difficult for you to be faster than the opponent. And if you are not fast enough, the outcome is already doomed. It can be said that this martial arts is very strong when you practice it, but the requirements are too high. You have to be extremely fast, faster than any opponent, in order to kill with one blow."

"I understand." Lin Feng knew that the other party was reminding him with good intentions. If the sword was not drawn quickly enough, the sword drawing technique would not only fail to draw the sword and drink blood, but would have the opposite effect and put him in danger.

"As long as you know it clearly, it's better not to use it randomly if you're not sure. This fleeting glimpse is actually a good body and martial arts skill." The old man didn't say much and helped Lin Feng register. After all, the martial arts skills selected in Xingchen Pavilion must be returned within a month and cannot affect other sect disciples who want to practice.

"Thank you for your advice, senior." Lin Feng took over the martial arts skills and then respectfully thanked the old man.

"Yes." The old man nodded with a smile: "This soft sword can be used as a belt. It is of no use to me. You can play with it."

"Don't thank me. The old man can't bear it. Go and practice." When the old man saw Lin Feng, he wanted to thank Lin Feng again and waved with a smile.

Lin Feng touched his head, kept his gratitude in his heart, and drew his sword skills. If paired with a soft sword that could be hung on the waist, the chance of a surprise and a one-shot kill would be greatly increased.

Lin Feng smiled and nodded at the old man, and then left.

"I haven't seen such an interesting young man for a long time." The old man whispered, and then returned to his lazy look. Today's young people are only focusing on practicing to improve their strength, becoming more and more impetuous, and have long forgotten basic etiquette.
